verification: Independent Python implementation of format-v1 hash and bit encoding; same fixed probes as Rust unit test
present_key_formula: UTF-8 bytes of present-{i:024}, i in 0..4096 (exclusive upper bound)
absent_key_formula: UTF-8 bytes of absent--{i:024}, i in 0..100000 (exclusive upper bound)
bit_numbering: LSB-first within each byte, byte index floor(bit/8)
